reason: DUPLICATE_WEBHOOK plan version 3: the outbox redelivery count (DUPLICATE_REDELIVERIES_<n>) is the LOCAL FIXTURE driver's own account of the messages it re-published, not an emulator or inbox record, so it moves from an emulator_log reach rule to a driver_self_report rule that can never set reached or reachedFault (FO-17-11, WP-01 ADR decision 1). The telephony emulator rule is unchanged; expectations, trigger and effect are unchanged. The change narrows the reach rules (outbox-path runs become INCONCLUSIVE), so it is not a relaxation. Recorded against the uncommitted corpus-lock.v1 baseline (plan digest before/after) when the lock format moved to corpus-lock.v2.
